newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Cabinet shuffle won't affect Russia Eurobond plans.
newsitem.headline: Cabinet shuffle won't affect Russia Eurobond plans.

text.p: Russia's plans to issue new Eurobonds and service its existing Eurobond will not be affected by a cabinet shuffle announced on Tuesday, Itar-Tass news agency quoted Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin as saying.
"The forthcoming reorganisation of the government will not change the Russian Federation policy on issuing and placing Eurobonds," Chernomyrdin was quoted as saying.
"A new cabinet of ministers will undoubtedly carry out obligations on placed Eurobonds."
President Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday ordered a full reorganisation of the government, leaving only Chernomyrdin and a First Deputy Prime Minister, clearly Anatoly Chubais, in place.
Government officials are presenting Russia's second Eurobond, to be denominated in marks with a tentative volume of between 1.5 and two billion marks, in a two-day road-show ending on Wednesday.

Russia placed its debut $1 billion Eurobond, which was heavily oversubscribed, in November and government officials have said Russia planned to raise a total of $3 billion through Eurobond issues this year.
